headline: Besley-Persson's legal-fiscal complementarity is STABLE across 1975-2024 (standardized slope r 0.50/0.64/0.52 by era, E2-vs-E0 difference not significant, p=0.22); legal origin PERSISTS as the most durable determinant on successor capacity measures while war and parliamentary democracy WEAKEN, and the move away from trade taxation continues to 6 countries in 2023 (below the update's 2010 count of 7).

figures.caption: Legal-fiscal complementarity by era (common sample N=148): standardized slope (correlation r) of income-tax/GDP on private credit, pooled and within both income halves, with Fisher 95% CIs. Positive and significant in all three eras; peaks in E1 (2000-2012), stable E0/E2; carried by the high-income half, weaker in the low-income half. Era boundaries 2000/2012 are SPEC-CHOICE.
figures.alt: Point-and-error-bar plot over three eras; pooled correlation around 0.5-0.64 and always above zero; high-income-half points high, low-income-half points lower but all three above zero (after the 003-C2 half_label fix the E2 low-half is significant, p=0.0395)

figures.caption: Fiscal-capacity march away from trade taxation (Q3): countries with trade tax > 40% of total taxes on GRD 2025 fall 27 (2000) -> 15 (2010) -> 6 (2023), orange. DP16256's 2021 vintage (blue, ~20 in 2000, 7 in 2010) runs lower at each date - a vintage difference - so 2023 is graded direction-only; the decline continues and 2023 sits below the update's 2010 level.
figures.alt: Line chart; orange GRD-2025 line declining 27-15-6 across 2000, 2010, 2023; dashed blue DP16256 line at 20 and 7 for 2000 and 2010, running below the orange line

notes: These are conditional cross-country correlations, exactly as the paper itself labels its evidence (pp. 1235, 1241); nothing here is causal, and no verdict below upgrades or downgrades the paper's causal claims, because it made none.

Branch R (reconstruction; openICPSR 113314 deposit pending the human gate): suspect cells carry pending-deposit; this study adjudicates no printed typo and uses no suspect-cell stars as evidence. Reuses study 001's frame_update.csv read-only.

mcollective16 (the authors' own 2021 collective-capacity index) is graded 'not separable (coverage)': merged estimation N=63, index non-missing set N=67 (DP16256's full set), below the N>=80 floor; reported descriptively with N stated. No substitution of the coll_cap panel mean (would change the construct).

Q3 reproduce-then-extend rule triggered: GRD 2025 gives 15 trade-tax-dependent countries in 2010 vs DP16256's 7 (outside +/-3), a vintage difference (every tax denominator gives 14-15), so the 2023 count is graded direction-only. Pre-named outcome, not a failure.

Novelty: the first re-estimation of the AER 2009 Tables 1-2 specification (external-war incidence 1816-1975 + democracy and parliamentary-democracy incidence to 1975 + legal origins, on the paper's outcome battery or its successors) on any post-publication data, and the first grading of those patterns out of sample (checked against the update's published do-files and dataset; literature search 2026-11-05). Adjacent work exists (DP16256 2021; Cardenas-Tuzemen 2011); only the narrow battery claim is asserted.
